ui_bugs.issue: Default date on new Add Transaction sheet shows 07/29/2001 instead of today. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 1733 sets dateLabel = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) which produces 'Jul 29' (no year). TxForm then does new Date('Jul 29') at line 1789 which JS engines parse as year 2001. If the user saves without touching the date, the transaction is persisted with a 2001 date and the wrong month/period. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/screenshots/s4_txform_default.png and /app/test_reports/screenshots/s_income_mode.png both show 07/29/2001.

issues: 3-column layout looks clean but subCol width is fixed 62px each (styles line 3187-3188). On 390px viewport a long subcategory name is truncated to numberOfLines=1 which is acceptable. No overflow observed on Give/Steward/Grow.

action_items: Fix TxForm default date year=2001 bug. Recommended fix: at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 1735, pass an ISO date instead of 'Jul 29'. E.g. `date: now.toISOString()` (TxForm already parses ISO cleanly). Alternatively include the year in dateLabel: `now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })`. Verified via UI: the date input shows 07/29/2001 by default on every fresh 'Add transaction' open.
Optional: run manual test that saving with default date now produces today's ISO in tx.date.

TxForm date parsing at line 1789 tolerates ISO but not month-day strings; the fix should be on the setter side (line 1735), not here.

rca_of_issue: BUG — Default transaction date = 2001-07-29. Reproduction: 1) Log in as alex+test1@jaleter.app. 2) Go to Transactions tab. 3) Tap the '+' (testID tx-add). 4) Observe the Date field shows 07/29/2001 (or 07/current-day/2001). Root cause: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 1733 builds dateLabel via now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) which returns e.g. 'Jul 29' (no year). At line 1735 this is stored into editing.date. TxForm at lines 1787-1791 does `const d = new Date(t.date)` — JS parses 'Jul 29' as year 2001 (V8/JSC default when year missing). The <input type='date'> then binds to 2001-07-29 and users who don't tap the picker will save 2001-dated transactions. Mitigation: change line 1735 to `date: now.toISOString()` OR add year to dateLabel. Confirmed by two independent screenshots (s4_txform_default, s_income_mode) both show 07/29/2001 as the pre-filled value.
